Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Sunita - 39 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Ishaan - 10 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya thinks for a moment.]

Sunita (surprised): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Night falls and the stars come out.]

Aditya: "How beautiful!"

[Dark clouds gather in the sky.]

Aditya: "I'm ready!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Sunita (surprised): "Let's see."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Let's begin."

[Aditya sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Aditya: "Yes, of course."

[Aditya mops the floor.]

Aditya (laughing): "Yes, all right."

[Aditya irons his school shirt.]

Aditya: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 3: The terrace - Day

[Aditya stands on the terrace. Sunita stands near him.]

Sunita: "Aditya, look over here."

[Aditya flies a kite on the terrace.]

Sunita: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
